scope_comparison: DiMarino–Lewin–Nenna's current v3 counterexample explicitly uses six separated nuclei with small fractional charges. Making total charge an integer still leaves multiple nuclei and is not one attractive -Z/r nucleus with integer Z. General Coulomb-model/molecular nonconvexity, Pauli–Fierz photon models and helium-dianion N=4 results do not settle all N,Z of the fixed one-nucleus target.
